Thanks for working on this. 

For background, currently, when the node is shutting down, the status of the node will be updated to `NotReady` since the `nodestatus.ReadyCondition` takes into account `kl.shutdownManager.ShutdownStatus`

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/af46c47ce925f4c4ad5cc8d1fca46c7b77d13b38/pkg/kubelet/kubelet_node_status.go#L608

where `ShutdownStatus` checks if the node is currently shutting down:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/af46c47ce925f4c4ad5cc8d1fca46c7b77d13b38/pkg/kubelet/nodeshutdown/nodeshutdown_manager_linux.go#L181-L193

However, the issue with this is the node status will only be updated periodically, i.e. every `nodeStatusUpdateFrequency`

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/af46c47ce925f4c4ad5cc8d1fca46c7b77d13b38/pkg/kubelet/kubelet.go#L1394

which is set to 10seconds by default:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/af46c47ce925f4c4ad5cc8d1fca46c7b77d13b38/pkg/kubelet/apis/config/v1beta1/defaults.go#L125-L127

As a result, it means there can be some delay between when the shutdown first occurs and when the kubelet will sync it's node status. I think having the kubelet explicitly sync it's status when the shutdown happens as you proposed here makes sense.

thanks for the fixes, left a few small nits.

Can you please retitle this PR / commit as it's current title is a bit confusing. 

Maybe something along the lines of `Sync node status during kubelet node shutdown` and a note that this PR also adds an pod admission handler that rejects new pods when the node is in progress of shutting down. Thanks again!

issue_context.body:

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:

A node is in shutdown state. all the pods are down, but the pods are rescheduled to this node.

**What you expected to happen**:

No new pod will be scheduled to the node of shutdown state.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

**Anything else we need to know?**:

**Environment**:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): v1.20.1
- Cloud provider or hardware configuration:
- OS (e.g: `cat /etc/os-release`): 7
- Kernel (e.g. `uname -a`):  Linux zsm-test-2 3.10.0-1160.11.1.el7.x86_64 SMP Fri Dec 18 16:34:56 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
- Install tools:
- Network plugin and version (if this is a network-related bug):
- Others:

review_comments:
can we please add a unit test that exercises this functionality and tests:

1. pods are not admitted when `nodeShuttingDownNow == true`
2. pods are admitted when `nodeShuttingDownNow == false`
Since the dependencies changed, you need to run the update-bazel.sh script. This is why the tests are failing.
